sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Thoughts vanish, with drawing pressure in
forehead. Sensibility increased, even from mere im-
agbiation.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Compressive i)ain. Tension of scalp; hair
painful. {China.} Coryza, wdth sneezing.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Feel stiff; burn; feel cold. Better, in cold
air or water ; worse, sunlight and wind. Darting pains
in eyes after operations. Asthenopia.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Sensation as if plugged up. Catarrh with
deafness.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Loss of appetite, flatulence, eructation,
and vomiting. Desire for alcoholic drinks. Smoking-
tobacco tastes bitter. Nausea ; worse after eating. Clean
longue. Great faintness. Accumulation of cold, watery
saliva.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Strings of odorless, yellow mucus pass
from bowels. Diarrhcea of tough mucus. Undigested
stools. Prolapse.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses too early, long lasting, black. Vio-
lent pain in small of back. Tenacious, yellow leucor-
rhoea.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Nervous, hacking cough. Short res-
piration.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Paralytic pain in muscles of nape of neck.
Weakness, with staggering.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Chilliness, single parts get icy cold. Easily
excited perspiration.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, in cold dry weather ; penetrat-
ing sounds. Better, from washing; in damp and wet
weather.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : I^ecnc., especially in diar-
rhoea; Silica; Nux; China.
